sloka: उपास्य रात्रि शेषम् तु शोणा कूले महर्षिभिः ।निशायाम् सुप्रभातायाम् विश्वामित्रो अभ्यभाषत ॥१-३५-१॥
transliteration: upāsya rātri śeṣam tu śoṇā kūle maharṣibhiḥ ।niśāyām suprabhātāyām viśvāmitro abhyabhāṣata ॥1-35-1॥

translations.english: Viswamitra lay on the bank of Sona with the ascetics, for the rest of the night. (Getting up) at daybreak he said:
